description.zh: ? 一句话：按文档讲的是什么来找，不用记得原词。用你选的模型（“本地模型”插件或 Ollama，都在本机、不上传；或云服务的密钥）
description.en: ? a sentence: finds documents by what they are about, not by their words. Uses the model you pick (the Local models plugin or Ollama, on this PC with nothing uploaded; or a cloud service's key)

notes.zh: 每种模型服务只用卡片上为它列出的几项，各家云服务各存各的密钥（硅基流动、阿里云百炼、OpenAI、自定义；原来那个共用的密钥在没单独填时照样用），切换服务不会把这家的密钥发给那家。本地模型不再读共用的接口地址：以前留着别家的地址时请求会发到那里、报 401，现在总是连本机；它用的模型由本地模型插件决定。Win顺 0.53.0 起卡片只显示所选服务要填的几项，旧版本照旧全部显示。权限不变。
notes.en: Each model service reads only the fields its card lists, and each cloud service keeps its own key (SiliconFlow, Bailian, OpenAI, custom; the shared key still serves one without its own), so switching never sends one service's key to another. The local model no longer reads the shared endpoint: an address left there from another service sent its requests there (401); it now always stays on this PC, with the model the Local models plugin gives. From WinShun 0.53.0 the card shows only what the chosen service needs; older versions show every field as before. Permissions unchanged.
